entry.title: New: dsh-plugin-qcc
entry.summary: Qichacha (企查查) enterprise data source as a dynamic Cordis plugin: 5 agent tools (auth with QR login, company search, knowledge search, tool search, tool execute) covering 100+ data dimensions (business registration, shareholders, judicial, IP), plus a settings-page account manager; network/file IO via DSH subprocess spawning node -e, credentials interop with the local BizOwl client. Exact install spec: github:samge0/dsh-plugin-qcc. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
